app.name: Cobalt
app.tagline: Your private memory for notes, study and work, shared across all your AIs

shell.desktopOnlyTitle: Cobalt runs as a desktop app
shell.desktopOnlyDesc: Cobalt runs as a desktop app — open it with pnpm dev:app (or launch the installed desktop app). No browser preview or sample data is served here.

tiers.ecoDesc: Minimal RAM and battery usage, no shadows, 30 FPS cap.
tiers.balancedDesc: Great balance between semantic quality and smoothness (USearch + E5 Base).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure language, hardware profile, vector engine and embedding model.
settings.displayNameHint: Used for the welcome greeting when you open Cobalt. Leave blank to hide it.
settings.proModeDesc: Unlocks advanced search tuning, MCP tool docstrings, REST API and external engines.
settings.readOnlyDesc: Prevents AI tools from writing or modifying your memories.
settings.appearanceSubtitle: Control how installed 3D themes render on this device.
settings.disableThemeShadersDesc: Use Cobalt's built-in renderer instead of custom GLSL shaders from installed themes. Saved on this device only.

settings.captureSubtitle: Keep your memory automatically up to date as you work with your files and AI assistants.
settings.captureIndexingPausedDesc: Temporarily pauses automatic folder watching and background re-indexing until you resume.
settings.captureAutoWatchDesc: When you import a folder or an AI works inside a project, Cobalt keeps its files indexed and up to date in the background.
settings.captureSessionHandoffsDesc: When an AI session finishes, saves a short temporary summary of recent progress so your next AI can pick up where you left off.
settings.captureGitCommitsDesc: Saves a short note for each recorded change (commit) and automatically re-indexes the modified files.
settings.engineSubtitle: Change the tier, vector engine or embedding model selected during onboarding.

ocr.title: Text in images (OCR)
ocr.subtitle: Local optical character recognition for images and scanned PDFs.
ocr.description: Reads text from images (screenshots, photos, diagrams) and scanned PDFs so it becomes searchable in your memory and across your AIs. Everything runs 100% locally on your device, with nothing sent to the cloud.
ocr.paddleLanguageNote: Full Latin alphabet: accents, ñ, ü, ¿ (no ¡).
ocr.ocrsLanguageNote: Basic letters only: no accents, ñ, ü, ¿, or ¡; slightly better on code screenshots.
ocr.accuracyWarning: OCR can make mistakes with both handwritten and computer-generated text (small or decorative fonts, blurry or low-quality images, noisy backgrounds, tables, or columns). Double-check important details (numbers, names, codes) in the original file.
ocr.useThisRequiresInstall: Install this engine first to use it.
ocr.activeNotInstalledHint: Install it to read text in images and scanned PDFs, or choose the other engine below.

comparison.title: OCR engine comparison
comparison.measuredNote: Measured on an Intel i3 (lower errors, time, and memory are better).

connectors.title: AI Connectors
connectors.subtitle: Connect Cobalt in one click so all your AI assistants share the same local memory.
connectors.backupSafetyNote: A .bak backup is always created before editing any config file.
connectors.manualSetupDesc: Prefer configuring it yourself? Paste this snippet into your AI client's settings file.
connectors.manualHintJson: Inside "mcpServers" if the file already exists; restart your AI afterwards.
connectors.manualHintToml: At the end of the file if it already exists (TOML format); restart Codex afterwards.
connectors.httpEndpointHint: Local Streamable HTTP endpoint also available at {{url}}

capture.title: Automatic capture
capture.subtitle: Keeps Cobalt up to date even when your AI assistants forget to save or look things up on their own. Every option is optional and reversible.
capture.privacyNote: Everything stays on your device, passes through secret filtering and ignore rules (.memoryignore), and automatically pauses whenever Read-Only mode is enabled.

global_instructions.title: Global instructions for your AIs
global_instructions.plainExplanation: Adds a short guide to your AI assistant's instructions file reminding it to check your rules, search before asking again, and save key decisions. Turning it off removes only that block.
global_instructions.empty: No compatible AI assistants found for global instructions.

session_hooks.title: Live session activity & handoffs
session_hooks.plainExplanation: Lets Cobalt notice right away when your assistant edits files so your memory stays fresh and saves a short temporary handoff when the session ends, without ever slowing down your tool.
session_hooks.empty: No compatible AI assistants found for session events.

git_hooks.title: Saved project changes (Git)
git_hooks.plainExplanation: Whenever you save a change (commit) in a project, records a short note of what changed and re-indexes those files. Any existing project automation is preserved safely.
git_hooks.empty: Once you link a project folder that uses Git, you can enable it here.
